column1: What is an IP Address?;A unique number assigned to every device on a network (like a home address for computers).;networking
What is DNS?;Domain Name System. It translates human-friendly names (google.com) into IP addresses.;networking
What is a Router?;A device that directs traffic between your local network and the internet.;networking
What is the difference between TCP and UDP?;TCP guarantees delivery (reliable)
column2: UDP sends faster but doesn't guarantee delivery (streaming).;networking

What is localhost (127.0.0.1)?;Your own computer. It refers to itself.;networking
What is a Packet?;A small unit of data sent over a network.;networking
What is Latency?;The delay before a transfer of data begins following an instruction (ping).;networking
